meta.source: Synthetic stand-in (same schema as UCI dataset)
steps: Parsed Date+Time into a timestamp, sorted, removed 0 duplicate timestamps
Found 233 missing sensor values -> median imputation (fitted on training split only)
Engineered 8 features: sensor means/max/spread, PIR sum, log(CO2)
Target: occupant count 0-3 (multi-class), plus occupied/empty (binary) for ROC analysis
Standardised all features (z-score) - required for KNN distances and logistic regression
Feature selection: SelectKBest keeps the top 10 of 24 features inside every pipeline

insights: Lights were on for 55.6 h but the room was empty for 12.4 h of that (22%).
Heaviest use is around 11:00, 15:00, 16:00; plan cleaning and HVAC boost for those windows.
The room is empty 49% of the time - a candidate for auto-off lighting and setback HVAC.
